claims.claim: fetch() returns a Promise that resolves to a Response for a completed HTTP response.
A fetch promise does not reject merely because an HTTP response has a 404 or 500 status.
Response.ok is true for statuses in the inclusive 200–299 range.
Response.json() reads a response body and returns a Promise resolving to JavaScript data parsed as JSON.
The Fetch Standard defines the fetch() JavaScript API and fetch processing.
